## Weekday draft digest
Separate from the Job URL Form workflow. Read-only: does not change status and does not apply.

Schedule (workflow timezone America/Winnipeg):
cron `0 8,18 * * 1-5` — weekdays at 08:00 and 18:00.

Keeps rows whose status is exactly `draft_ready`. No matches: no email.

Local Docker n8n must be running and this workflow published. A slot is missed if the container is stopped.

After import, confirm Google Sheets + Gmail credentials. Same spreadsheet / applications tab as the scoring workflow. Gmail To is mack.hatcher1@outlook.com — edit Send Digest if you want another inbox.
